_comment: Sample brand-flavored comment corpus (Christian / devotional voice). Copy to config/comment-corpus.brand.json (gitignored — your own additions stay local) or merge phrases you like into config/comment-corpus.json directly. Skills read config/comment-corpus.json by default; this file shows what a curated domain-specific set looks like.

_authoring_rules.no_terminal_punctuation: skip periods/exclamation marks — they read formal/bot. Apostrophes inside words are fine (god's / he's).
_authoring_rules.no_self_promo: never reference your own brand / app / URL in a comment
_authoring_rules.voice: casual social-native, devotional + encouraging. Brief enough that repetition isn't immediately obvious.
